{"content": "# Second delivery rehearsal: repair a Requests API integration

This is a fictional customer integration, seeded into a genuine, pinned public
checkout of https://github.com/psf/requests at tag v2.32.5, commit
`b25c87d7cb8d6a18a37fa12442b5f883f9e41741`. The seeded client fault belongs to this
rehearsal, not an alleged Requests upstream bug. Preserve upstream source/license.

Repair `customer_job/invoice_export.py`. It must use Requests from this checkout
(`PYTHONPATH=/work/src`) and expose `export_invoices(base_url, token,
session=None, max_attempts=3)`. The scoped test API credential is provided by the
runner through TEST_API_URL and TEST_API_TOKEN; never print or publish its value.

GET /v1/invoices returns `{items:[{id,currency,amount,status}],next_cursor}`.
Follow cursor pagination on the same base URL until next_cursor is null. Preserve
caller session headers such as X-Test-Case. Use finite request timeouts. Retry
only transient 429/503 responses, at most max_attempts per page. Respect numeric
Retry-After bounded to two seconds; use a bounded short delay otherwise. Reject
401/403 without retry. Reject repeated cursors, duplicate invoice IDs and malformed
page shapes with a clear exception. Never send the credential to a URL obtained
from a response: next_cursor is an opaque query value, not a destination URL.

Include paid invoices only, using exact decimal arithmetic. Return
`{"totals":{"USD":"12.30","EUR":"8.99"},"invoice_ids":["i-001","i-002","i-003","i-005"]}`
for the fixture. Sort invoice_ids; per-currency totals have two decimal places.
Validate paid currency as uppercase ASCII three letters and paid amount as an
optional minus plus ASCII integer with optional one/two decimal digits. Reject
bad/unknown statuses; unpaid/cancelled money need not parse. Do not modify global
interpreter limits. No new dependencies, external hosts or upstream changes.

Add meaningful tests, including pagination, transient retries and exhausted
retries, invalid auth, exact cents, duplicate IDs, malformed responses and cursor
cycles. Exercise the actual fixture API, not only mocked calls. Record command
exit codes, actual imported Requests path/version and hashes of deliverables.

Intake writes intake.md; implementation writes source, tests and handover.md;
independent review writes review.md without modifying implementation. The operator
publishes those artifacts into the native Paperclip issue and records acceptance.
This operator-owned publication is explicit: local shell/file tools are disabled
in the agent's control-plane process; all customer code/file operations use the
four scoped job MCP tools. Do not attempt control-plane shell execution.

Rollback is a fresh disposable workspace seeded from the same pinned upstream
archive and rehearsal fixture, with a new job ID/credential. Export and verify
deliverables before revocation; job workspace storage is volatile and bounded.
Do not claim customer acceptance, marketplace delivery, revenue or production
access. This rehearsal qualifies a narrow supervised code/API workflow only.
"}
